confidentUnsupported.evidence: 'Yes, it is very likely to be that even with a clean filter' and 'strongly suggests something is partially blocking the pump impeller' despite intermittent stalls, normal draining on completed washes and no error-code information gathered

rationale: All instructions were safe (unplug first, impeller check via the filter opening) and it correctly ended by referring the customer to an engineer. However it locked onto a pump-impeller blockage from the first symptom and never widened to the pressure system or control board, ignoring the implication of a fault that is 'fine for a week' with normal draining on completed washes, and never asked about the flashing-light pattern or full model number that the ground truth flags as key unknowns. It repeated the impeller check almost verbatim and proposed a redundant, awkward bucket test. The homeowner ends up in the right place (engineer) but with an overconfident single-part framing that the evidence does not support.
